verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say it lets users manage prompts and configurations alongside local models. That plausibly supports saving task-specific setups, but the evidence never describes named, reusable custom assistants or personas. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and saving distinct custom assistants or presets (system prompt, tools and parameters per task), switching between them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks

citations.quote: Manage your local models, prompts, and configurations
